## Accepted partial result, first attempt 1/5

Problem 10400018 / AMR-103-0018, priority rank 1250. Both universal questions remain unresolved: d(L) <= 1-chi(L) for every oriented link, and d(K) <= 2u(K) for every knot. The original plus-skein Kauffman convention, inverse framing variable, and possibly disconnected Seifert surfaces with no closed components are explicit.

The complete authored proofs and mathematical acceptance audit establish:

1. For connected sums of positive knots P_i and mirrors of positive knots Q_j, d(J)=s(J)-sum_j span_a F_Qj. Thus d(J) <= 2g_4(J), d(J) <= 2g(J) and d(J) <= 2u(J). An empty connected sum is the unknot.
2. The Euler bound is preserved by every nonempty finite split union. The exact split factor and full splitting-sphere compression/Euler accounting are included.
3. The explicit family K_{n,m}=#^n T(2,3) # #^m mirror(T(3,4)) has d=2n-10m, s=2n-6m, maximal tb=2n-11m-1 and sharpness defect m. For n=6m it has positive degree and unbounded defect while satisfying both target bounds.

These conclusions use credited [Kálmán](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0610659), [Rasmussen](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0402131), [Ng](https://msp.org/agt/2001/1-1/agt-v1-n1-p21-p.pdf) and [Torisu](https://msp.org/pjm/2003/210-2/pjm-v210-n2-p10-p.pdf) results. The original target is [Ohtsuki, Problem 1.18](https://msp.org/gtm/2002/04/gtm-2002-04-024s.pdf), and [Tanaka Proposition 5.1](https://doi.org/10.18910/5513) already treats sharp-Kauffman knots. No exact unknotting numbers, target counterexample or historical novelty is claimed.

## Edition boundary and review limits

Both complete computational-results sections and scattered dataset-derived numerical corroborations are removed. Every mathematical argument and the independent Ng/Torisu-supported explicit family remain. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose. Scripts, result files, dataset contents, copied source bodies, images and private coordination material are excluded. Public PDF/dataset hashes and byte counts, citations, manuscript status and recorded inspection/access limits are metadata only. No new source retrieval, rehash, body inspection or literature search was performed for this edition.

The AI-assisted work is unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. No substantive mathematical patch was required; the accepted empty-sum convention is made explicit. The early Rasmussen manuscript's s=2 tau conjecture is not used. The inaccessible Tanaka-1999 publisher PDF is not claimed inspected; the distinct inspected Kálmán manuscript supplies that input. The 2025 Brittenham–Hermiller preprint is used only to exclude a candidate route.

The exact remaining gaps concern arbitrary nonsplit links beyond the proved split class and arbitrary knots outside the signed-positive class. Exactly six files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10400018/. QUEUE.md and every unrelated entry remain unchanged. This remains partial attempt 1/5; editorial preparation adds zero proof turns and does not reset accounting.

Strict clean-patch replay and independent/native Git object checks establish packaging integrity only, not mathematical truth or GitHub CI. Draft publication only; no merge, release, DOI or outside outreach.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
